fusions.name: Ledge Ram
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4s after using it.

fusions.name: Scattering Kick
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 5 damage and is knocked back 1 tile. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sure Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. You also gain +10% dodge chance for it, and move 15% faster for 5s after using it.

fusions.name: Cornered Pride
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, your physical damage rises by 30% for 8 seconds and you gain +8% dodge chance. Once every 40 seconds.
